svg.title: Runtime release closeout (2026-10-23)
svg.desc: Bounded shared-agent runtime, ownership/cancellation, incremental observations, checked workflows, persistent SDKs, frame coverage and on-demand inspection/diagnostics are implemented. Final product 9542ee5 passed 418 local tests (one expected skip), 17 smoke checks, visible GUI/live loading checks, and the 1/4/8/16/32-client semantic grid. The final-build observation journey reduced response tokens by 51.5–57.9% with exact reconstruction.
